scenario_generation.forecast_leg_noise: independent Uniform[0.97, 1.03] per non-diagonal leg, multiplied by nominal duration and forecast multiplier
scenario_generation.realized_leg_noise: independent Uniform[0.90, 1.10] per non-diagonal leg, multiplied by nominal duration and latent realized multiplier
scenario_generation.group_split: shuffle scenario indices with split_seed; first 12 train, next 6 validation, final 6 test; keep each scenario and all its routes in one group
scenario_generation.common_random_numbers: all three methods receive the identical forecast scenarios; all selected plans are checked against the paired identical realized scenarios

information_boundary.decision_features: nominal source inputs, forecast travel matrix, forecast-generated route candidate travel cost, and nominal route window pressure
information_boundary.hidden_until_after_selection: realized travel matrix, realized route timing, realized SLA labels, validator objective
information_boundary.training_labels: for train scenarios only, route SLA-event indicator from separately sampled realized travel
information_boundary.validation_and_test_labels: never passed to model fitting, model selection, feature selection, calibration, or plan selection

model_and_decision.ansatz: CNOT(0,1), RY(theta0) q0, RY(theta1) q1, CNOT(1,0)
model_and_decision.route_features: x0=clip(forecast route travel_cost/30,0,1); x1=1-clip(nominal minimum stop slack/4,0,1)
model_and_decision.risk_adjusted_route_estimate: forecast route travel duration + predicted SLA-event probability * sum(contract penalty rates) * 1 minute
model_and_decision.decision_loss: soft minimum (temperature 2.0) over exact-cover forecast-feasible plans, weighted by paired validator-recomputed realized objective on train scenarios
model_and_decision.optimizer: 120 full-batch parameter updates per model; VQC decision learning rate 0.025; predictive VQC learning rate 0.08; classical logistic 500 updates at 0.3
classical_comparators: predictive-only VQC trained on train-group SLA labels
logistic regression trained on the same train-group route rows
model_and_decision.reference: exact tiny solver on realized test inputs, then independent validator recomputation

reporting.claims: synthetic simulation only; no operational currency claim, forecast calibration claim, quantum advantage claim, QpiAI SDK execution claim, cloud claim, or QPU claim
